daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Performance Rankings with Rolling Averages
daily_quests.description: Using the ASX 200 historical prices dataset, write a SQL query with window functions to: (1) Calculate the 20-day and 50-day rolling average closing price for each stock, (2) Rank stocks by their current price relative to the 20-day average (highest outperformers first), (3) Use ROW_NUMBER to identify the top 3 performers in each sector for the most recent date in the dataset. Return columns: ticker, sector, date, close_price, ma_20, ma_50, performance_rank, sector_rank. Use a CTE to organize the window function logic.

daily_quests.title: Australian Weather Data Cleaning & Temperature Anomaly Detection
daily_quests.description: Download or load the Australian Weather observations dataset (Bureau of Meteorology). Write a Python/pandas script to: (1) Handle missing values in temperature and rainfall columns using appropriate imputation strategies, (2) Detect and flag outliers in daily maximum temperature using IQR method, (3) Create new columns: temperature_anomaly (difference from 30-year average for that location/month), rainfall_category (low/medium/high based on percentiles), (4) Export cleaned data to CSV with a timestamp. Document your data quality checks and decisions in comments.
daily_quests.dataset: Australian Weather Observations — Bureau of Meteorology / Kaggle (jsphyg)

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Analysis: Python ETL + SQL Analytics
daily_quests.description: Using NSW Road Crash Data (data.nsw.gov.au): (1) Write a Python script to extract crash records, clean location coordinates (handle nulls/invalid entries), standardize crash type and severity codes, and load into a local SQLite database. (2) Write SQL queries to analyze: top 10 crash locations by frequency, average severity score by day-of-week and hour-of-day (use CASE statements and GROUP BY), identify crash patterns using a CTE that flags high-risk corridors (>50 crashes in 12 months). (3) Export a summary report showing geographic hotspots and temporal patterns. Include error handling in Python and document data transformations.
